parsed.title: Develop and Deploy New Features Using Version Control Systems

steps.description: Clone the project repository from version control using Git.
Create a new branch for feature development using Git.
Write unit tests for the new features using Python's unittest framework.
Commit changes to the feature branch with descriptive commit messages.
Merge the feature branch into the main branch using Git merge strategy.
Tag the merged commit with a meaningful tag name.
Push the merged branch to the remote repository.
Automatically deploy the new features using a continuous integration server like Jenkins.

parsed.title: Maintain and Monitor Infrastructure as Code

steps.description: Initialize Terraform configuration files for infrastructure management.
Apply Terraform configurations to create, update, or destroy resources using Terraform CLI.
Use Ansible playbooks to automate deployment processes across multiple environments.
Set up monitoring systems using Prometheus and Grafana to track resource usage and performance.
Configure logging and error handling mechanisms within the infrastructure.
Regularly audit and validate the infrastructure against security standards using tools like AWS Security Hub.

parsed.title: Analyze Logs and Metrics for Troubleshooting

steps.description: Collect log data from various sources using ELK Stack components.
Analyze log data using Logstash filters and outputs to extract relevant information.
Generate reports and visualizations using Kibana dashboards based on analyzed log data.
Identify patterns and anomalies in the log data that may indicate issues.
Review and prioritize tickets related to identified issues by assigning them to appropriate teams.
Collaborate with developers and operations teams to resolve reported issues.

parsed.title: Perform Security Audits and Penetration Testing

steps.description: Initiate a penetration testing engagement using a third-party vendor.
Prepare test scripts and payloads for vulnerability assessment.
Execute the penetration tests according to predefined protocols.
Document findings and vulnerabilities discovered during the tests.
Communicate the results to stakeholders including IT security team and business leaders.
Implement remediation actions based on the findings and recommendations provided.

parsed.title: Optimize and Scale Applications for High Traffic

steps.description: Analyze traffic patterns and user behavior using APM tools like New Relic.
Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the application architecture.
Implement caching strategies using Redis or Memcached to reduce load times.
Scale applications horizontally by adding more instances of the application using Kubernetes or AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
Monitor the scaled environment using CloudWatch and set up alarms for critical thresholds.
Adjust scaling policies dynamically based on real-time traffic conditions.
